description: Defines data structures and classes for managing NGAP UE (User Equipment) contexts, including context list management, with functions for adding, removing, and querying UE contexts, as well as handling identifiers and timers.

classes.name: ngap_ue_context
classes.description: Represents the context of a UE in NGAP, including identifiers, timers, and related info.

classes.name: ngap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a collection of UE contexts, providing methods for adding, removing, and querying UEs, and handling identifier allocations.

methods.name: get_cu_cp_ue
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the associated NGAP CU-CP UE notifier.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks existence of UE by RAN UE ID, UE index, or AMF UE ID.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses UE context by RAN UE ID, UE index, or AMF UE ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds UE context by RAN UE ID or AMF UE ID, returns nullptr if not found.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE context with specified identifiers and notifier.

methods.name: update_amf_ue_id
methods.description: Updates the AMF UE ID associated with a given RAN UE ID.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index and notifier for a given UE.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context based on UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Allocates and returns the next available RAN UE ID.
